epic: Customer master data realistic data route
purpose: Decide whether existing U-CUST-100 / Universaarl Kunde 100 should be renamed into the realistic target customer Saarland Maschinenbau AG or parked as a placeholder before any customer write gate.
businessPurpose: Prevent unrealistic placeholder data from becoming the first handbook/O2C customer and avoid duplicate customer creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision names the preferred path for U-CUST-100 before any write gate.
Decision keeps realistic fictional data separate from confidential real customer data.
Decision states whether the next live work is rename/update, create-new, or further read-first proof.
No Business Central or Playwright live execution occurs in this case.
stopIf: The decision would require live BC observation.
The decision would claim setup readiness.
The decision would use real confidential customer data.
decision: U-CUST-100 remains the preferred first realistic customer number, but the existing placeholder must be checked read-first before any conversion write gate.
preferredPath: Run CUSTOMER-U-CUST-100-DEPENDENCY-READFIRST. If no critical dependencies are observed, later convert U-CUST-100 into Saarland Maschinenbau AG with a narrow write gate and reopen proof.
fallbackPath: If dependencies exist or cannot be proven, park U-CUST-100 as technical learning/placeholder data and use a new realistic fictional customer number.
